entry.title: Roadmap Deck
entry.summary: A published, diagram-free slide deck used to prove a deck with no diagrams never pulls the Mermaid runtime onto its route (the NFR-002 footprint guard).
entry.content:
Roadmap Deck

This deck deliberately contains no diagrams, so its route must resolve zero Mermaid runtime chunks — the footprint guard short-circuits before importing Mermaid.

Where we are

A short text-only slide.

Where we are going

Another text-only slide, so the deck has more than one slide boundary for reveal to enhance.
